description: An egg-shaped cam turns and lifts a spring-loaded follower; no engine, valve or camshaft chain shown

facts.intro: Introduce a recognizable cam and follower: an orange egg-shaped cam on a shaft, a flat-footed steel follower resting on it, a coil spring above and a red cap on top. Everything is still, with the follower down.
facts.cutaway: Inside are the cam, the flat foot of the follower, its brass collar and the spring above it.
facts.drive: A turn spins the cam. As the wide side of the egg rolls under the foot, the follower is pushed up and the spring is squeezed.
facts.response: The cam keeps turning and the narrow side comes round. The squeezed spring pushes the follower back down, so the foot stays on the cam.
facts.hold: No part moves for this explanation. The follower only slides straight up and down; the cam only turns; the shape of the cam sets how high the follower goes.
facts.repeat: Two more turns of the cam raise and lower the follower twice. Each turn gives the same lift, because the cam shape does not change.
facts.limit: The cam turns backwards for a moment. The follower still rises when the wide side arrives, so the cam shape, not the turn direction, sets the lift.
facts.payoff: Cam, follower and spring work together: a steady turn becomes a repeating up and down push. No engine or valve is shown.
